slides.say: For every number x, five times diamond of x, minus three x, is equal to eight plus four times diamond of x. Diamond of four is equal to what?
Diamond of x appears on both sides of the equation. [short pause] We'll treat diamond of x like an unknown, and isolate it.

[short pause] Think of diamond of x as one unknown, like a box. On the left there are five boxes, and on the right there are four boxes. To get all the boxes on one side, we subtract four boxes from both sides. On the right, the four boxes are gone, and eight is left. On the left, we have five boxes minus four boxes, minus three x.
at: subtract four boxes from both sides

slides.say: Five boxes minus four boxes is one box. So diamond of x minus three x is equal to eight. Now add three x to both sides, and diamond of x is three x plus eight. Now it's an ordinary definition.
Now put four into the same template. Three times four is twelve, and twelve plus eight is twenty. Choice number two is our answer. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
at: Choice number two is our answer
